summary: Iter-39 full verification of Digital Signatures Phase 1 (tablet-at-desk model). Backend pytest test_signatures.py: 14/14 PASS (direct function-level + Cloudinary mocked via monkeypatch). New HTTP-level smoke suite test_signatures_http.py: 9/9 PASS against live preview URL (unauth 401, admin/pad poll, invalid role 400, signer_name trim, duplicate-cancels-first, invalid-base64 rejected, cancel, list-for-job). Frontend Playwright against live preview URL: /dashboard/signing-pad as pad-il renders [data-testid='pad-idle'] with 'Signing pad ready' + 'Waiting for the next signature request…' + 'Polling every 2s'; no sidebar visible (full-bleed kiosk). After admin POSTs a request via API, the pad swaps within 5s to [data-testid='pad-active-capture'] with pad-canvas + pad-clear + pad-submit + signer-name shown. /dashboard/jobs Job Detail dialog as admin: [data-testid='signature-section'] renders above [data-testid='job-activity-list'] (regression-clean); [data-testid='capture-signature-button'] opens [data-testid='capture-menu'] showing all 4 role buttons (client_drop_off, client_collection, cert_collection, courier_drop_off). Clicking a client role opens [data-testid='capture-request-dialog'] with signer-name-input pre-filled with the client name ('TEST_ActivityClient_b7fb14'); courier_drop_off pre-fills empty as spec'd. [data-testid='send-to-pad-button'] POSTs the request and surfaces [data-testid='pending-signature-banner'] with [data-testid='cancel-pending-signature'] which cancels the row server-side. Activity timeline shows new 'signature_requested' / 'signature_deleted' rows with proper labels. NO bugs detected.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/signatures.py is well-bounded (~390 lines), single responsibility, async I/O throughout. Cloudinary SDK is correctly wrapped in asyncio.to_thread for both upload and destroy — won't block the event loop.
Mongo _id consistently excluded from the API response (via _serialise's `id: str(row.get('_id'))`). LGTM.
Branch-scoping logic for GET /signatures/pending elegantly falls back to 'any branch' for users with no branch_id (super_admin global catch-all pad). This matches the spec.

The duplicate-pending-replacement uses an update_one cancel + insert_one, NOT a transaction — there's a tiny race where two near-simultaneous admin clicks could both insert new rows. Acceptable for Phase 1 (single-admin-per-desk model) but worth flagging if Phase 2 ever supports collaborative editing on the same job.

submit_signature rejects payloads < 100 decoded bytes as 'empty', > 2 MiB as 'too large', and malformed base64 as 'invalid' — all three paths covered by tests. Pydantic min_length=20 on the SubmitSignaturePayload model means HTTP clients sending shorter payloads get a 422 (from FastAPI's request validation) before reaching the route logic; that's fine but documented in test_signatures_http.py's invalid-base64 test (had to pad to >=20 chars).

delete_signature swallows Cloudinary destroy exceptions with logger.exception and still removes the DB row — sensible (cleanup-best-effort) but means an orphaned Cloudinary asset can linger silently. A periodic reconciliation job is worth considering longer-term.

Frontend signing-pad page is built with next/dynamic + ssr:false for react-signature-canvas, which is the correct pattern (canvas needs window). Sidebar exclusion on /dashboard/signing-pad confirmed at runtime (aside not visible).

Frontend SignatureSection.tsx data-testids are complete and match the spec exactly. Capture menu, role buttons, request dialog, signer-name-input, send-to-pad button, pending-signature-banner and cancel-pending-signature all wired correctly with API integration verified end-to-end.
